Fully funded UK government award for a one-year master's degree at a UK university, including tuition, living costs, travel, and visa support for emerging leaders. Applications for 2026-2027 Chevening Scholarships are currently closed. When open, apply through the official Chevening online application system. Apply portal: https://www.chevening.org/apply/ Application timeline: https://www.chevening.org/scholarships/application-timeline/

scholarships.title: Chevening LSE Fellowship
scholarships.description: Chevening LSE Fellowship is funded by the UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office and hosted by London School of Economics and Political Science (LSE). Mid-career research fellowship in social sciences with emphasis on international relations, public policy, development studies, and related fields. Eligible nationality: China. Duration: 3, 6, or 9 months (start October). Applications for the current Chevening fellowship cycle are closed. When open, apply through the official Chevening fellowships application process. Chevening apply portal: https://www.chevening.org/apply/

scholarships.title: Chevening India Cyber Security Fellowship
scholarships.description: Chevening India Cyber Security Fellowship is funded by the UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office and hosted by Cranfield University (Defence Academy, Shrivenham). Mid-career fellowship for Indian professionals in cyber security and cyber policy covering threats, governance, law, and digital resilience. Eligible nationality: India. Duration: 10 weeks (March–May). Applications for the current Chevening fellowship cycle are closed. When open, apply through the official Chevening fellowships application process. Chevening apply portal: https://www.chevening.org/apply/

scholarships.title: Chevening Healthcare, Health Policy, and Health Reform Fellowship
scholarships.description: Chevening Healthcare, Health Policy, and Health Reform Fellowship is funded by the UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office and hosted by University of Oxford. Research fellowship for mid-career health and social policy professionals aligned with UK global health priorities. Eligible nationality: China. Duration: 6 months (October–April). Applications for the current Chevening fellowship cycle are closed. When open, apply through the official Chevening fellowships application process. Chevening apply portal: https://www.chevening.org/apply/

scholarships.title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
scholarships.description: The Fulbright Foreign Student Program enables graduate students, young professionals, and artists from abroad to study and conduct research in the United States at participating universities.

scholarships.title: Fulbright FLTA Program
scholarships.description: Fulbright Foreign Language Teaching Assistant (FLTA) grants place early-career teachers of English or foreign languages at US colleges for one academic year to teach language and culture.

scholarships.title: DAAD In-Country / In-Region Scholarships
scholarships.description: DAAD In-Country and In-Region scholarships support postgraduate study for candidates in Sub-Saharan Africa at selected universities, often with a development-focused master's curriculum.

scholarships.title: DAAD EPOS — Development-Related Postgraduate Courses
scholarships.description: DAAD Development-Related Postgraduate Courses (EPOS) fund international graduates from developing countries to pursue development-oriented master's degrees at German universities.

scholarships.title: DAAD Research Grants
scholarships.description: DAAD Research Grants support highly qualified doctoral candidates and young academics to carry out research or doctoral work in Germany at universities or research institutions.

scholarships.title: DAAD Study Scholarships
scholarships.description: DAAD Study Scholarships provide funding for international graduates to complete a full master's degree programme or additional study at a state or state-recognised German university.

scholarships.title: DAAD Study Stipends
scholarships.description: DAAD Study Stipends support individual semesters or short study visits for international students at German higher education institutions under defined programme rules.

scholarships.title: DAAD Graduate Schools
scholarships.description: DAAD funding for structured graduate schools supports doctoral researchers within organised programmes at German universities, often with interdisciplinary training.

scholarships.title: DAAD Undergraduate Scholarships
scholarships.description: DAAD undergraduate scholarships support international students for bachelor's-level study or preparatory programmes at German higher education institutions where offered.

scholarships.title: Australia Awards Scholarships
scholarships.description: Australia Awards Scholarships are long-term development awards funded by the Australian Government. They support study at participating Australian institutions for people from partner countries in the Indo-Pacific and beyond.

scholarships.title: Australia Awards — Africa and Indo-Pacific
scholarships.description: Australia Awards for Africa support citizens of eligible African countries to undertake postgraduate study, research, and professional development in Australia in priority development fields.

scholarships.title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters
scholarships.description: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters are integrated, international master's programmes delivered by consortia of EU and partner universities, often with EU-funded scholarships for top-ranked applicants worldwide.

scholarships.title: Erasmus Mundus Catalogue
scholarships.description: The Erasmus Mundus Joint Master catalogue lists accredited joint degree programmes and scholarship opportunities administered through the European Education and Culture Executive Agency.

scholarships.title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program
scholarships.description: The Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program partners with universities and NGOs to provide holistic support—tuition, living costs, leadership training—for academically strong young Africans from disadvantaged backgrounds.

scholarships.title: Mastercard Foundation Scholars — Research
scholarships.description: Mastercard Foundation research on the Scholars Program documents programme outcomes and university partnerships that expand access to tertiary education for talented African youth.

scholarships.title: Mandela Rhodes Scholarship
scholarships.description: The Mandela Rhodes Scholarship develops exceptional young African leaders through postgraduate study at South African universities, combined with leadership development and mentorship.

scholarships.title: Ashinaga Africa Initiative
scholarships.description: The Ashinaga Africa Initiative supports orphaned students from Sub-Saharan Africa through university preparation, tuition, and living expenses for undergraduate study abroad or in Africa.

scholarships.title: Aga Khan Foundation — Education Scholarships
scholarships.description: Aga Khan Foundation education scholarships assist outstanding students from select developing countries who lack other means of financing postgraduate study, with a focus on development-related fields.

scholarships.title: Federal Scholarships Board (FSB) — Nigeria
scholarships.description: Nigeria's Federal Scholarships Board administers federal government awards for undergraduate and postgraduate study abroad and in Nigeria, including bilateral and commonwealth-linked schemes.

scholarships.title: ELIMU & Jomo Kenyatta Foundation Scholarships — Kenya
scholarships.organization: Ministry of Education — Kenya / Jomo Kenyatta Foundation
scholarships.description: Kenya's ELIMU and Jomo Kenyatta Foundation scholarships support deserving students through secondary and tertiary education via government and foundation partnerships.

scholarships.title: NSFAS — South Africa
scholarships.description: NSFAS provides financial aid to eligible South African students at public universities and TVET colleges, covering tuition and allowances according to means-tested criteria.

scholarships.title: Government of Ghana Scholarship for Tertiary Education
scholarships.description: The Government of Ghana scholarship for tertiary education supports eligible Ghanaian students pursuing approved programmes at accredited institutions according to Ministry of Education guidelines.

scholarships.title: Ethiopia Foreign Study Programmes
scholarships.description: Ethiopia's Ministry of Education foreign study programmes coordinate government-sponsored opportunities for Ethiopian students to pursue higher education abroad in priority disciplines.
